caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a woven seat. The chair features four legs, all of which are rounded and extend slightly outward at the bottom. The seat is made up of a crisscross pattern of woven material, likely a natural fiber, attached to the wooden frame. The backrest consists of three horizontal slats which are also wooden and have a slightly curved, organic shape. The two vertical posts of the backrest are rounded and extend above the top slat, curving slightly outward. There are additional horizontal supports connecting the legs near the bottom on each side and across the front and back. The chair is rendered in muted, natural tones of brown and beige, giving it a wooden appearance. The drawing is centered on a plain, light background. In the lower right corner, there is text that reads “JOE BRENNAN JR.”
title: Braided Rawhide-bottomed Chair
